ATL.name: Jock Landale
ATL.detail: Landale (hip) is out for Sunday's game against Bucks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: Kingston Flemings
ATL.detail: Flemings (back) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bucks.

ATL.name: Mouhamed Gueye
ATL.detail: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: Keshon Gilbert
ATL.detail: Gilbert (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Bulls.

ATL.name: Asa Newell
ATL.detail: Newell (toe) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Chicago.

ATL.name: Henri Veesaar
ATL.detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

CHA.name: Kon Knueppel
CHA.detail: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

CHA.name: Dennis Schroder
CHA.detail: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

DAL.name: Santi Aldama
DAL.detail: Aldama (ankle) is out for Sunday's game against the Celtics.

DAL.name: Max Christie
DAL.detail: Christie (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Celtics.

DAL.name: Kyrie Irving
DAL.detail: Irving (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Celtics.

DAL.name: Dereck Lively II
DAL.detail: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Thursday's game in Minnesota.

DAL.name: Tarik Biberovic
DAL.detail: Biberovic (heel) is out for Thursday's game against Minnesota.

DAL.name: Sergio de Larrea
DAL.detail: De Larrea (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game at Minnesota.

DET.name: Duncan Robinson
DET.detail: Robinson (thigh) did not return to Saturday's 137-117 win over the Pistons. He finished with 10 points (3-8 FG, 2-6 3Pt, 2-2 FT), one rebound and one assist across 17 minutes.

DET.name: Ugonna Onyenso
DET.detail: Onyenso agreed to a two-way contract with the Pistons on Thursday.

DET.name: Isaiah Joe
DET.detail: Joe (hip) is out for Monday against the Wizards.

DET.name: Jalen Duren
DET.detail: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

IND.name: Andrew Nembhard
IND.detail: Nembhard (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 76ers, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

IND.name: Tyrese Haliburton
IND.detail: Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

IND.name: Johnny Furphy
IND.detail: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

IND.name: Ben Sheppard
IND.detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

LAC.name: Brandon Ingram
LAC.detail: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Friday's game against the Thunder, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

LAC.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
LAC.detail: Niederhauser (foot) is out for Tuesday's game against Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

LAC.name: Bradley Beal
LAC.detail: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

LAC.name: Jordan Miller
LAC.detail: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

LAL.name: Austin Reaves
LAL.detail: Reaves (heel) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Suns, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.

MIL.name: Ousmane Dieng
MIL.detail: Dieng will undergo a procedure to repair a fractured left finger Monday, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.

MIL.name: Ryan Rollins
MIL.detail: Rollins (illness) is out for Sunday's game against the Hawks.

SA.name: De'Aaron Fox
SA.detail: Fox (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jazz.

SA.name: Tobias Harris
SA.detail: Harris (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Chicago, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.

SA.name: Jayden Quaintance
SA.detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

TOR.name: Nate Bittle
TOR.detail: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet.ca reports.

TOR.name: Kevin McCullar Jr.
TOR.detail: McCullar signed a two-way contract with the Raptors on Thursday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

TOR.name: Kawhi Leonard
TOR.detail: Head coach Darko Rajakovic said Wednesday that Leonard (knee) is doing individual on-court work and is progressing well, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

UTAH.name: Jaxson Hayes
UTAH.detail: Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Spurs.

UTAH.name: Trey Alexander
UTAH.detail: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

UTAH.name: Lauri Markkanen
UTAH.detail: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

UTAH.name: Jusuf Nurkic
UTAH.detail: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

UTAH.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
UTAH.detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
